title: TriggerEventResponse
description: Result of accepting a webhook event for asynchronous delivery

eventId.description: Pub/Sub message ID for this event. Correlates with delivery logs and with the Idempotency-Key sent to subscribers.

matchedWebhooks.description: Active webhooks matching this event type at accept time. Not a delivery guarantee. A value of 0 usually means the event type is misspelled or nothing is subscribed to it; -1 means the subscription lookup failed and the count is unknown (the event was still published).
